name: FPP Remote Monitoring Plugin (FPPMon)
author: Daniel Kulp (dkulp)
description: Monitor and control FPP instances (and Falcon, Genius, WLED and Baldrick controllers) from the FPPMon mobile and desktop apps. Sign in with a KulpLights account (kulplights.com); the instances you select then report their status to mqtt.kulplights.com, which is how the apps reach them from off your network.

privacy.summary: Lets the FPPMon phone and desktop apps watch and control the players you pick, by way of KulpLights' server. Nothing leaves this device until you sign in and choose them.

sends.what: your KulpLights account name and password
sends.why: to sign in, from the plugin's page in your browser

sends.what: the status of the players you picked, and replies to what the app asks of them
sends.why: so the FPPMon app can show and control them from anywhere

sends.to: http://the players and controllers you pick on your network
sends.what: status requests, and whatever the app asks them to do
sends.why: to read their status and pass on what the app asks

collects.where: plugindata/fpp-FPPMon/, cleared by Logout on the plugin page

systemChanges.what: holds an outgoing connection to mqtt.kulplights.com that the app reaches this player's FPP pages through

privacy.other: Only apps signed in to the same KulpLights account reach this player, and only while you are signed in on it; signing out on the plugin page ends it. The plugin runs as a prebuilt binary whose source is not published. It sends nothing to the developer beyond what the app asks for.
